# Self-hosted terminal components

- @xterm/xterm 6.0.0: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xterm/xterm/v/6.0.0
- @xterm/addon-fit 0.11.0: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xterm/addon-fit/v/0.11.0

Copied from the official NPM release archives after checking their SHA-512
integrity values. Original MIT licenses are included beside the assets.
JavaScript is loaded from the authenticated RemoteGate backend only when a
terminal opens. The browser makes no request to an external CDN.
